# PanePilot v0.6.0

PanePilot 0.6 makes project files easier to read and manage, adds lightweight Codex
conversations, and improves movement between projects and sessions.

## Highlights

- Open Markdown files in a sanitized GitHub-style Preview with tables, task lists,
  alerts, autolinks, heading anchors, fenced-code highlighting, and a per-tab Source
  mode. Preview renders the current unsaved draft.
- Follow relative Markdown links inside the project and load relative images through
  PanePilot's bounded local/SSH preview path; external links continue through the
  validated system-browser bridge.
- Create empty files and folders, rename entries, download authoritative files, and
  copy exact local or SSH paths from the Files explorer, preview header, or Monaco
  context menu. Mutations remain project-bounded and never overwrite collisions.
- Open persistent project-scoped Quick Codex chats from the toolbar or Command-K
  without adding them to ordinary terminal tabs. Chats remain until explicitly
  cleared, while Codex's provider archive stays untouched.
- Transfer an ordinary terminal to another active project on the same connection.
  Live tmux metadata is retagged before PanePilot moves durable ownership.
- Scale the whole interface—including xterm, Monaco, and rendered documents—between
  90%, 100%, 110%, and 125%, with client-local persistence and keyboard controls.
- See Public, Private, Internal, or Unknown GitHub visibility in the Repository action.
  The read-only check uses the authenticated GitHub CLI first and the public API as a
  fallback; it never guesses or changes repository visibility.
- Scroll working-tree status and the all-branch Git graph as one continuous pane;
  bounded history pages load near the bottom with a manual fallback.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads.

PanePilot Remote for Android remains available as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First-launch note

This desktop build is not signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarized. After
copying PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and
confirm the launch. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this GitHub repository.
